description: Every search-free program computes a total primitive-recursive unary function.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.UniversalComputation.searchFree_eval (c : Nat.Partrec.Code)
  (h : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.UniversalComputation.SearchFree c) :
  ∃ f, Nat.Primrec f ∧ c.eval = fun x => Part.some (f x)
